heroSummary: HCPS students start school on Monday, August 10, 2026, and the last day is Friday, May 28, 2027, with a 2.5-hour early release. Fall Break is November 23–27, 2026, Winter Break is December 21, 2026–January 1, 2027, and Spring Break is March 22–26, 2027. Students return Tuesday, March 30, after an additional non-student day on March 29.

sourceReviewDetails: We checked first and last days, Fall Break, Winter Break, Spring Break, non-student days, student return dates, grading-period dates, semester dates, and the published local calendar notes against the HCPS calendar sources.

HCPS lists Fall Break during Thanksgiving week, November 23–27, 2026. This page uses the parent-friendly phrase Fall Break (Thanksgiving week) to preserve the official label while making the timing clear.
HCPS changed the Strawberry Festival non-student day from March 1 to March 8, 2027, to align it with the festival schedule.
The 2025–26 comparison uses the HCPS 2025–26 student academic calendar. Check the official HCPS calendar page for later revisions or hurricane make-up announcements.

calendarFaqs.q: When is the first day of school for HCPS in 2026?
calendarFaqs.a: The first day of school is Monday, August 10, 2026.

calendarFaqs.q: When is the last day of school for HCPS in 2027?
calendarFaqs.a: The last day of school is Friday, May 28, 2027, with a 2.5-hour early release. Other student early-release dates have not yet been finalized.

calendarFaqs.q: When is Fall Break for HCPS in 2026?
calendarFaqs.a: Fall Break is November 23–27, 2026. It falls during Thanksgiving week, and students return Monday, November 30.

calendarFaqs.q: When is Winter Break, and when do students return?
calendarFaqs.a: Winter Break runs December 21, 2026, through January 1, 2027. January 4 is a non-student day, and students return Tuesday, January 5.

calendarFaqs.q: When is Spring Break, and when do students return?
calendarFaqs.a: Spring Break runs March 22–26, 2027. Students are also off Monday, March 29, so classes resume Tuesday, March 30.

calendarFaqs.q: Do HCPS students have school on February 12, 2027?
calendarFaqs.a: No. HCPS lists Friday, February 12, 2027, as a non-student day for the Florida State Fair.

calendarFaqs.q: When is the Strawberry Festival non-student day?
calendarFaqs.a: The Strawberry Festival non-student day is Monday, March 8, 2027. HCPS changed it from March 1 to March 8 to align it with the festival schedule.

calendarFaqs.q: Can HCPS use scheduled days as hurricane make-up days?
calendarFaqs.a: Yes. HCPS identifies October 12, November 11, November 23–25, and January 4 as tentative hurricane make-up dates if needed. Check the district calendar before making plans around those dates.

calendarFaqs.q: Does the ICS file update automatically?
calendarFaqs.a: No. The ICS file is a one-time import and will not automatically sync with later HCPS revisions.

calendarFaqs.q: Where can families check for HCPS calendar revisions?
calendarFaqs.a: Use the official HCPS calendar page and school announcements for final confirmation of revisions, emergency schedule changes, and school-specific dates.
